behaviors.name: lists_each_declared_unit
behaviors.description: scan reports every materialized logical unit under its concrete unit name

behaviors.name: records_hard_edge_between_dependent_units
behaviors.description: a declared hard edge between two units is emitted as a model edge on their concrete names

behaviors.name: keeps_own_member_out_of_external
behaviors.description: a dependency on another unit of the project is an edge, never an external dependency

behaviors.name: scan_is_deterministic_across_runs
behaviors.description: an unchanged tree scans to byte-identical JSON across runs

behaviors.name: test_project_absent_from_production_model
behaviors.description: a project whose package set names a test runner contributes no unit, edge, soft tier, or external fact, and the tree minus that project scans to identical JSON

behaviors.name: test_tier_follows_framework_evidence_not_name
behaviors.description: a no-framework project named LegacyTests stays production while a project named Helpers referencing xunit is test tier

behaviors.name: test_framework_package_ids_are_the_decisive_evidence
behaviors.description: xunit/nunit-family and Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk package ids mark the test tier while FluentAssertions-only stays production

behaviors.name: central_test_reference_marks_tier_version_entries_do_not
behaviors.description: a centrally declared test-runner PackageReference marks the owning project test tier; a version-only pin marks nothing

behaviors.name: conditional_props_reference_is_not_evidence_or_dependency
behaviors.description: a Condition-bearing central PackageReference is ignored entirely — the production model stays intact and the conditional runner reaches no tier

behaviors.name: using_dropped_test_project_namespace_stays_out_of_production
behaviors.description: a production using under a dropped test project's namespace produces no edge, module, seed boundary, or verify finding

behaviors.name: model_states_roles_map_per_language
behaviors.description: the roles map states the entries each driver derives from its own facts on the canonical tree: rust names its mod-declaration-only roots `facade`, c# names its DI-wired entrypoint root and go its `package main` unit `composition`, and every stated value comes from the closed vocabulary

behaviors.name: roles_map_never_states_facade_where_fact_not_emitted
behaviors.description: on a driver whose table marks role-facade not-emitted the roles map states no facade value anywhere while its own derived entries stay stated — honest absence per path, never a guessed stand-in

behaviors.name: lists_declared_modules_in_soft_structure
behaviors.description: every declared module of a unit appears as a soft_structure path under that unit

behaviors.name: nests_child_modules_under_parent
behaviors.description: a nested module is listed with its full dotted path, nested under its parent

behaviors.name: keeps_modules_of_distinct_units_separate
behaviors.description: soft structure is scoped per unit; one unit never lists another unit's modules

behaviors.name: records_module_edge_from_internal_using
behaviors.description: a using/import from one declared module to another records a module edge

behaviors.name: does_not_create_module_edge_to_external_target
behaviors.description: a using/import of an external package produces no module edge

behaviors.name: no_module_edges_for_units_without_soft_reference
behaviors.description: a unit whose modules reference nothing emits no module edges

behaviors.name: lists_manifest_declared_packages_as_external
behaviors.description: manifest-declared packages appear in the external dependency list

behaviors.name: sorts_and_deduplicates_external_entries
behaviors.description: external dependencies are sorted and deduplicated even when declared twice

behaviors.name: central_props_package_reaches_external_tier
behaviors.description: a centrally declared PackageReference item reaches the external tier, its module_external attribution, and fires a forbid rule

behaviors.name: nearest_props_file_overrides_root_for_central_entries
behaviors.description: each project's central entries come from the nearest props file walking upward; a project-level props shadows the root

behaviors.name: unreferenced_props_entries_stay_out_of_external
behaviors.description: props PackageVersion entries no project references never appear as external dependencies

behaviors.name: attributes_external_dependency_to_its_module
behaviors.description: an external package used by a module is attributed to that module path

behaviors.name: keeps_external_usage_off_sibling_modules
behaviors.description: only the module that uses an external package records it, never its siblings

behaviors.name: misaligned_package_identity_replaces_namespace
behaviors.description: a using whose namespace misaligns with its referenced package id attributes the package (longest shared prefix), never the namespace; siblings sharing only a shorter prefix stay unattributed and namespaces stay in the soft tier

behaviors.name: aligned_package_id_attributed_case_insensitively
behaviors.description: an aligned package whose id differs from its namespace only in case attributes the package id as referenced

behaviors.name: declared_but_unused_package_stays_out_of_module_external
behaviors.description: a referenced package no using surfaces stays out of module_external but present in the unit manifests

behaviors.name: uncompilable_namespace_absent_from_external_tiers
behaviors.description: a using that maps to no referenced package appears nowhere in the external tiers with no crash or placeholder entry

behaviors.name: family_root_using_ties_family_sibling_packages
behaviors.description: a using of a family root namespace sharing its longest prefix with the root package and a sibling package extending it attributes both (documented tie)

behaviors.name: exposes_dependency_facts_per_unit
behaviors.description: unit_manifests surfaces the manifest-declared packages of each unit

behaviors.name: unit_manifests_cover_every_unit
behaviors.description: every materialized unit has an entry in unit_manifests

behaviors.name: unit_without_packages_has_empty_dependencies
behaviors.description: a unit with no declared packages reports an empty dependency list

behaviors.name: unit_boundary_matching_tree_verifies_clean
behaviors.description: a unit-boundary spec declaring every unit with its edges allowed verifies clean

behaviors.name: module_boundary_with_allowed_dependency_verifies_clean
behaviors.description: a module-boundary spec whose depend_on allows the module edge verifies clean

behaviors.name: undeclared_component_is_reported_missing
behaviors.description: a spec component matching no unit is reported as a missing component

behaviors.name: stale_allowed_dependency_reports_missing_edge
behaviors.description: a declared depend_on edge absent from the model fails non-strict verify with the canonical missing edge label, and the same tree minus the stale declaration verifies clean

behaviors.name: facade_rule_note_announces_facade_tierless_driver
behaviors.description: on a driver whose table marks role-facade not-emitted verify states the facade rule inert instead of staying silent, with the verdict and exit status unchanged

behaviors.name: undeclared_dependency_exceeds_allowed_ceiling
behaviors.description: an extracted edge no boundary declares fails with the cross-component ceiling label, and an explicit ban reroutes it to the forbidden-edge label

behaviors.name: dead_reference_to_source_module_classifies_per_language
behaviors.description: an undeclared depend_on target is classified by model visibility: a target addressable as a module path reports exists in source but undeclared, one addressing nothing on an exact-import-path driver reports does not exist

behaviors.name: undeclared_unit_reports_unexpected_component
behaviors.description: a source unit no boundary declares is reported as an unexpected component

behaviors.name: dotted_subunit_of_declared_component_is_unassigned
behaviors.description: a unit nested under a declared component by name is reported as unassigned

behaviors.name: two_boundaries_claim_module_at_equal_specificity
behaviors.description: two boundaries claiming one module at equal specificity fail with the ambiguous-match report

behaviors.name: unclaimed_module_edge_endpoint_is_reported_unowned
behaviors.description: a module edge endpoint no boundary claims is a warning-level unowned endpoint, promoted by --strict; on go the endpoint's package is also an unclaimed unit, so the warning travels with unit-level findings

behaviors.name: top_level_contract_forbid_stereotype_surfaced_by_unit
behaviors.description: a boundary contract forbidding a stereotype whose pattern matches the claimed unit name leaks

behaviors.name: feature_boundary_gated_pattern_without_declaration_fires_where_emitted
behaviors.description: a feature_boundary gate naming no declared module fails on drivers whose table row emits root-module-declarations

behaviors.name: feature_boundary_missing_declarations_fact_surfaces_vacuous
behaviors.description: on a driver emitting no root-module-declarations fact the constraint surfaces once as a capability-reason vacuous warning, never as per-pattern errors

behaviors.name: rust_root_public_api_leak_pin
behaviors.description: a public root export outside the allowlist is reported as a public api leak

behaviors.name: rust_unverifiable_glob_export_pin
behaviors.description: a root glob re-export that resolves to nothing is reported as unverifiable

behaviors.name: rust_empty_glob_export_pin
behaviors.description: a root glob resolving to zero public items fails closed with the empty-glob label

behaviors.name: rust_unresolved_module_file_pin
behaviors.description: a module declaration with no source file is a warning-level unresolved module file, promoted by --strict

behaviors.name: acyclic_tree_passes_no_cycles_constraint
behaviors.description: a no_cycles constraint over an acyclic dependency graph verifies clean

behaviors.name: cyclic_tree_fails_no_cycles_constraint
behaviors.description: a no_cycles constraint over a cyclic graph fails and reports the cycle

behaviors.name: warning_severity_cycle_routes_to_warning_bucket
behaviors.description: a cycle caught by a warning-severity no_cycles constraint passes verify and renders in the warning bucket, promoted by --strict

behaviors.name: vacuous_cycle_constraint_surfaces_edgeless_group
behaviors.description: a no_cycles constraint over a module group with no internal edges reports vacuous and stays green

behaviors.name: cycle_through_a_test_project_is_invisible_to_production_guard
behaviors.description: a c# cycle carried only through a test-tier project leaves the production graph a DAG: the seed omits it and verify stays green (rust cfg(test) / go *_test.go parity)

behaviors.name: forbidden_external_dependency_is_reported
behaviors.description: a module using a forbidden external package is reported as a violation

behaviors.name: module_outside_forbid_list_passes
behaviors.description: a module not listed in the forbid constraint passes even when a sibling violates

behaviors.name: forbid_by_package_name_fires_on_misaligned_namespace
behaviors.description: a forbid rule naming the exact package id fires on a module whose only using maps to that package by longest shared prefix

behaviors.name: forbid_by_package_name_fires_on_aligned_namespace
behaviors.description: a forbid rule naming an aligned package id fires on the module that imports its namespace

behaviors.name: forbid_prefix_sharing_package_does_not_fire_on_longest_match
behaviors.description: a forbid rule naming a package that shares only a shorter prefix with the imported namespace does not fire (longest match attributes the real dependency)

behaviors.name: unused_reference_absent_from_module_external_but_in_manifests
behaviors.description: a referenced package no using surfaces is absent from module_external (no forbid fire) yet present in the unit manifests

behaviors.name: external_free_engages_the_serialized_module_tier
behaviors.description: an external_free pattern naming a module engages the module subtree on every module-tier driver: a pure match passes non-vacuously, contamination fails naming module and packages

behaviors.name: forbidden_dependency_in_manifest_is_reported
behaviors.description: a manifest declaring a forbidden dependency fails manifest_integrity

behaviors.name: manifest_matching_constraint_verifies_clean
behaviors.description: a manifest whose dependencies avoid the forbidden list verifies clean

behaviors.name: update_creates_spec_at_project_root
behaviors.description: update seeds an architecture.spec.toml at the project root

behaviors.name: seed_verifies_clean_against_itself
behaviors.description: verify against the just-generated seed reports no violations

behaviors.name: seed_omits_dotnet_test_projects_with_runner_evidence
behaviors.description: update omits a dotnet test project proven by runner-package evidence; the packable flag and the name play no part

behaviors.name: seed_test_tier_follows_cfg_gating_not_module_name
behaviors.description: the rust dialect of the seed test-tier provenance: a #[cfg(test)] module (a cfg on a root declaration, the `root-module-declarations` row this leg is keyed on) seeds no boundary while a module merely named tests seeds one with its production edge

behaviors.name: seed_omits_go_test_file_imports_and_marks_no_module
behaviors.description: the go dialect of the same provenance: imports carried only by *_test.go files seed no dependency and no module carries a test mark — keyed inert on `test-tier` because the table states go applies the exclusion at the file tier with no serialized mark

behaviors.name: report_emits_metrics_for_clean_project
behaviors.description: report prints metric rows and a clean result for a spec that matches the tree

behaviors.name: report_counts_units_and_components
behaviors.description: report counts one component per declared unit and every extracted unit

behaviors.name: report_json_findings_match_text_rendering
behaviors.description: report --format json parses, carries the same finding set as the text report, and exits 1 on violations

behaviors.name: report_json_clean_project_has_empty_findings
behaviors.description: a clean project reports empty findings and exit 0 in the json format

behaviors.name: report_restates_model_roles_verbatim
behaviors.description: the report restates the model's roles map exactly — the json roles field equals the scan map key for key, and the text report names each populated closed-vocabulary group with its model paths

behaviors.name: renders_a_node_per_source_file
behaviors.description: inspect renders a node per source file and the resolved file-level edge

behaviors.name: file_level_diagram_is_deterministic
behaviors.description: an unchanged tree renders a byte-identical file-level diagram across runs

behaviors.name: production_imports_never_target_test_files
behaviors.description: no production file-level import targets a test-tier file; test files stay nodes and import sources

behaviors.name: tree_view_renders_units_and_module_edges
behaviors.description: inspect tree renders one subgraph per unit with its module nodes and edges

behaviors.name: inspect_tree_marks_role_carrying_nodes
behaviors.description: every node whose model path carries a role entry renders its visible label suffixed with that role's marker, so why a node looks important reads off the diagram alone

behaviors.name: scanner_view_draws_unit_edges
behaviors.description: inspect scanner draws the cross-unit hard edges between unit subgraphs

behaviors.name: modules_projects_top_level_graph
behaviors.description: depgraph modules collapses nested module paths to top-level nodes and may draw several (cross product of folded top-nodes)

behaviors.name: api_usage_view_emits_table_contract
behaviors.description: depgraph api-usage emits the fixed-column table or the explicit no-usage statement

behaviors.name: submodules_view_scopes_to_parent
behaviors.description: depgraph submodules expands one parent into its children (plus mod) and the edges between them

behaviors.name: modules_mark_folded_role_carriers
behaviors.description: depgraph modules marks a rendered node exactly when the roles keys folded through the view's own projection state one distinct role there, so no marker appears without an entry and no entry the view can honestly name is dropped

behaviors.name: renders_a_node_per_declared_module_and_edge
behaviors.description: diagram renders a node per declared module and the declared dependency edge

behaviors.name: marks_forbidden_edge_dashed
behaviors.description: diagram renders a forbidden edge dashed and keeps allowed edges solid

behaviors.name: scan_mode_marks_role_carriers
behaviors.description: diagram --source scan marks exactly the nodes the model's roles map addresses under the `.`/`::` separator equivalence, and nothing else, so a node looks special in the diagram exactly when the model says it is

behaviors.name: init_creates_spec_declaring_language
behaviors.description: init writes an architecture.spec.toml that declares the detected language

behaviors.name: init_refuses_to_overwrite_existing_spec
behaviors.description: init refuses to overwrite an existing architecture.spec.toml

behaviors.name: prints_catalog_with_facade_and_laundered_entries
behaviors.description: `help diagnostics` exits 0 and quotes the facade and laundered-edge catalog entries

behaviors.name: import_of_facade_root_reexport_is_violation
behaviors.description: an internal module importing an item through a publication-only root is a facade dependency

behaviors.name: canonical_import_stays_clean_under_active_facade
behaviors.description: canonical imports never touch the facade root, so verify passes with the rule active

behaviors.name: umbrella_root_consumed_by_referencing_unit_is_violation
behaviors.description: a project referencing the umbrella consumes it through the root namespace (`using <Root>;`): the facade rule engages on the roles map and reports the cross-unit edge

behaviors.name: forbidden_edge_routed_through_conduit_hop_is_laundered
behaviors.description: a ban routed via an undeclared conduit module is reported as a laundered forbidden edge

behaviors.name: worktree_free_go_tree_enforces_laundering_without_tier_note
behaviors.description: a single-module go tree (no go.work) engages the laundering check directly: a fired rule reports the laundered finding, a clean run reports nothing, and neither run carries any tier note

behaviors.name: laundering_traces_only_claimed_conduit_territory
behaviors.description: a ban routed through a conduit whose territory a boundary claims is reported as laundered; the same conduit claimed by no boundary leaves the pair graph — no laundered line, only unexpected component (go) or unowned endpoints (soft tier) surfacing

behaviors.name: composition_root_wiring_sanctions_the_banned_bridge
behaviors.description: a ban whose route rides a hop owned by a composition-role-carrying boundary is sanctioned wiring — clean under `verify --strict`; the same edges without the composition role keep warning

behaviors.name: submodule_contract_leak_reported_under_submodule_path
behaviors.description: a contract.forbid stereotype surfacing under a submodule boundary leaks under the submodule's path

behaviors.name: go_submodule_contract_stereotype_needs_full_path_glob
behaviors.description: a submodule contract over go packages fires for a stereotype globbing the full import path under a parent that claims its units, and reads inert for a bare-name stereotype that matches no go unit

behaviors.name: forbidden_submodule_dependency_across_sibling_children
behaviors.description: an edge between sibling submodules banned by the parent constraint is reported with the submodule-dependency label

behaviors.name: forbidden_submodule_dependency_full_path_engages
behaviors.description: the same sibling-submodule ban expressed with full module-path from/forbid engages identically on every module-tier driver and is never reported vacuous

behaviors.name: scan_check_passes_on_fresh_artefact
behaviors.description: `scan --output` then `scan --output --check` exits 0 on the untouched file

behaviors.name: scan_check_fails_on_stale_artefact
behaviors.description: a modified artefact makes `scan --check` exit non-zero with the out-of-date finding
